claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted material decision in scope of the Pack maps to a named Senior Manager Function (SMF1, SMF3, SMF18, or SMF24) via the canonical KYE Authority Register.
Each material AI decision emits a signed, replay-derivable reasonable-steps Evidence Pack binding the SMF, SoR clause discharged, delegation chain, and Authority Finality outcome.
The Pack covers the six FCA Jan 2026 material-AI-decision triggers (customer outcome, vulnerable-customer treatment, pricing, complaints handling, suitability, product governance).
Conduct Rule breaches (CR1-CR5 and SC1-SC4) meeting the FCA SUP 15.3 materiality threshold emit a conduct-incident Evidence Pack routed dual-channel to SMF + compliance.
Designated SMFs co-sign a quarterly kye.compliance.attestation.v1 envelope covering their AI-assisted decision register and Conduct Rule breach disposition.
